ckd_stage.guideline: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for Chronic Kidney Disease

glycemic_progression.title: Concurrent Active Prediabetes and Established Diabetes Mellitus
glycemic_progression.guideline: ADA 2025 Standards of Care in Diabetes

heart_failure_stage.title: Mutually Exclusive Active Heart Failure NYHA / ACC Stages on Problem List

431855005.plain_description: Early kidney damage with normal or high filtration rate (eGFR >= 90 mL/min/1.73m2). Superseded when kidney disease progresses to stage 2 or stage 3.

431856006.plain_description: Kidney damage with mildly decreased filtration rate (eGFR 60–89 mL/min/1.73m2). Mutually exclusive with active CKD stage 1 or stage 3.

433144002.plain_description: Moderate decrease in kidney filtration function (eGFR 30–59 mL/min/1.73m2). Earlier CKD stages (stage 1 and stage 2) should be marked resolved once stage 3 is established.

431857002.plain_description: Severe decrease in kidney filtration function (eGFR 15–29 mL/min/1.73m2).

714628002.plain_description: Blood sugar levels higher than normal (HbA1c 5.7%–6.4%) but below the threshold for overt type 2 diabetes. Once overt type 2 diabetes or diabetic kidney disease develops, prediabetes should be resolved.

44054006.plain_description: Established Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (HbA1c >= 6.5% or fasting glucose >= 126 mg/dL); supersedes prior Prediabetes on the active problem list.

127013003.display: Disorder of kidney due to diabetes mellitus (disorder)
127013003.plain_description: Diabetic kidney disease (nephropathy) caused by long-standing diabetes damaging the small blood vessels and filters in the kidneys.

90781000119102.display: Microalbuminuria due to type 2 diabetes mellitus (disorder)
90781000119102.plain_description: Early leakage of small amounts of albumin protein into the urine caused by type 2 diabetes mellitus.

157141000119108.display: Proteinuria due to type 2 diabetes mellitus (disorder)
157141000119108.plain_description: Elevated protein in the urine due to diabetic kidney disease, indicating more advanced glomerular filter leakage than microalbuminuria.

59621000.plain_description: Chronic high blood pressure (typically >= 130/80 or >= 140/90 mmHg) that increases strain on the heart, arteries, and kidneys.

237602007.plain_description: Cluster of metabolic risk factors including high blood pressure, elevated blood sugar, excess abdominal weight, and abnormal cholesterol/triglyceride levels.

162864005.plain_description: Body mass index (BMI) of 30 kg/m2 or higher, which increases risk for hypertension, type 2 diabetes, sleep apnea, and heart disease.

414545008.plain_description: Coronary artery disease in which narrowed heart arteries reduce blood and oxygen supply to the heart muscle.

274531002.display: Abnormal findings diagnostic imaging heart+coronary circulat (finding)
274531002.plain_description: Imaging finding showing significant narrowing or blockage in the coronary arteries supplying the heart.

399261000.display: History of coronary artery bypass grafting (situation)
399261000.plain_description: Prior open-heart coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) surgery performed to route blood around blocked coronary arteries.

39898005.plain_description: Chronic disruption of normal sleep quality, timing, or breathing.

73430006.plain_description: Breathing repeatedly stops and starts during sleep, often treated with a continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) device.

271737000.plain_description: Lower-than-normal red blood cell count or hemoglobin level, which can cause fatigue and reduced oxygen delivery to tissues.

40055000.plain_description: Long-lasting inflammation and swelling of the nasal and sinus passages lasting 12 weeks or longer.

37320007.plain_description: Partial or complete absence of natural teeth due to extraction, periodontal disease, or dental decay, often managed with partial or complete dentures.

196416002.plain_description: Molar teeth (such as wisdom teeth) that are blocked from erupting normally through the gums.

66383009.plain_description: Inflammation of the gums caused by dental plaque buildup, treated with professional dental cleaning and topical fluoride/oral hygiene.

266948004.plain_description: Social history finding recording a prior criminal record stored on the active clinical problem list; highly privacy-sensitive when sharing health summaries outside direct care.
266948004.sharing_guidance: Highlight with a patient privacy notice in self-view ('patient_self') and redact automatically when exporting an external summary ('external_share').

706893006.plain_description: Confidential safety and social history finding documenting intimate partner violence/abuse; requires strict privacy protection to prevent unintended disclosure.
706893006.sharing_guidance: Highlight with a confidential safety/privacy notice in self-view ('patient_self') and redact automatically when exporting an external summary ('external_share').

423315002.plain_description: Social determinant of health finding indicating social isolation or limited support network; sensitive personal social information.
423315002.sharing_guidance: Tag as privacy-sensitive SDOH in self-view ('patient_self') and redact in external sharing mode ('external_share').

314529007.plain_description: Administrative care-management flag indicating that a routine clinician review of the patient's medication list is due.

224299000.plain_description: Social history background entry documenting completion of college or post-secondary education.

473461003.plain_description: Social history background entry documenting high school education.

160903007.plain_description: Social history entry indicating current full-time employment status.

160904001.plain_description: Social history entry indicating current part-time employment status.

700379002.plain_description: Moderate-to-severe decrease in kidney filtration rate (eGFR 30–44 mL/min/1.73m2); supersedes earlier CKD stage 1 and stage 2 diagnoses.

84114007.plain_description: Chronic heart condition in which the heart muscle does not pump blood as effectively as needed.

441481004.plain_description: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), where the left ventricle loses pumping strength.

14140009.plain_description: Elevated potassium level in the blood (> 5.0 mmol/L), which requires urgent medication review to prevent cardiac arrhythmias.

49436004.plain_description: Irregular, often rapid upper heart chamber rhythm that increases stroke risk and is typically managed with a single oral anticoagulant.

74474003.plain_description: Bleeding in the digestive tract (stomach or intestines), requiring careful reconciliation of blood thinners and avoidance of NSAIDs.

28651003.plain_description: Drop in blood pressure when standing up from sitting or lying down, causing dizziness, lightheadedness, and fall risk.

161898004.plain_description: History of falls, requiring a review of sedative, sleep, and blood-pressure medications under AGS Beers Criteria.

64859006.plain_description: Reduced bone mineral density that makes bones more fragile and increases fracture risk after a fall.

55600006.plain_description: Sensitive social determinant of health finding documenting social isolation or lack of support system.

58410-2.display: CBC panel - Blood by Automated count
58410-2.plain_description: Complete Blood Count (CBC) panel measuring red blood cells, hemoglobin, white blood cells, and platelets to screen for anemia, infection, and clotting status.

51990-0.plain_description: Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP) measuring blood glucose, kidney function (creatinine, BUN, eGFR), and key electrolytes (sodium, potassium, chloride, carbon dioxide, calcium).
51990-0.reference_range: Glucose (fasting): 70–99 mg/dL; Creatinine: 0.7–1.3 mg/dL; eGFR: >= 60 mL/min/1.73m2; Potassium: 3.5–5.0 mmol/L

24321-2.display: Basic metabolic 2000 panel - Serum or Plasma
24321-2.plain_description: Serum Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP) measuring blood sugar, kidney filtration markers (creatinine, BUN, eGFR), and electrolytes.
24321-2.reference_range: Glucose: 70–99 mg/dL; Creatinine: 0.7–1.3 mg/dL; eGFR: >= 60 mL/min/1.73m2; Sodium: 135–145 mmol/L; Potassium: 3.5–5.0 mmol/L

24323-8.display: Comprehensive metabolic 2000 panel - Serum or Plasma
24323-8.plain_description: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) covering kidney function, blood sugar, electrolytes, blood proteins (albumin), and liver enzymes (ALT, AST, alkaline phosphatase, bilirubin).
24323-8.reference_range: eGFR: >= 60 mL/min/1.73m2; Albumin: 3.5–5.0 g/dL; Total Bilirubin: 0.1–1.2 mg/dL

57698-3.display: Lipid panel with direct LDL - Serum or Plasma
57698-3.plain_description: Cholesterol and lipid panel measuring total cholesterol, LDL ('bad') cholesterol, HDL ('good') cholesterol, and triglycerides to assess cardiovascular risk.
57698-3.reference_range: Total Cholesterol: < 200 mg/dL; LDL: < 100 mg/dL (< 70 mg/dL in ischemic heart disease); HDL: >= 40 mg/dL; Triglycerides: < 150 mg/dL

4548-4.plain_description: Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) test measuring average blood sugar levels over the past 2 to 3 months.

33914-3.plain_description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), the primary measure of how well the kidneys filter waste from the blood.

2160-0.plain_description: Serum creatinine waste product filtered by the kidneys; rising creatinine indicates declining kidney filtration.

38483-4.plain_description: Blood creatinine level used to monitor kidney function.

24357-6.plain_description: Urine dipstick panel checking urine appearance, specific gravity, pH, protein, glucose, ketones, blood, and leukocyte esterase.
24357-6.reference_range: Urine protein: negative; Urine glucose: negative; Urine blood: negative

24356-8.plain_description: Complete urinalysis panel evaluating kidney protein leakage (albuminuria/proteinuria), glucose, and urinary tract findings.

34528-0.display: PT panel - Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay
34528-0.plain_description: Prothrombin Time (PT) and INR coagulation panel measuring how quickly blood clots during surgery or anticoagulant therapy.

24336-0.plain_description: Arterial Blood Gas (ABG) panel measuring blood pH, oxygen (pO2), carbon dioxide (pCO2), and bicarbonate during cardiac surgery or ICU care.

24339-4.plain_description: Venous Blood Gas (VBG) panel assessing acid-base balance, carbon dioxide, and venous oxygenation during inpatient/ICU care.

89577-1.display: Troponin I.cardiac panel - Serum or Plasma by High sensitivity method
89577-1.plain_description: High-sensitivity cardiac troponin I test used to detect heart muscle injury or heart attack (myocardial infarction).
89577-1.reference_range: < 0.04 ng/mL (or below sex-specific 99th percentile reference limit)

55405-5.plain_description: Cardiac monitoring panel (including natriuretic peptides / cardiopulmonary markers) used to track heart failure and perioperative cardiac recovery.

19123-9.plain_description: Serum magnesium electrolyte test monitored closely during cardiac surgery and ICU care to prevent heart rhythm disturbances.

2777-1.plain_description: Serum phosphorus/phosphate level monitored in chronic kidney disease and inpatient care.

3173-2.display: aPTT in Blood by Coagulation assay
3173-2.plain_description: Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT) coagulation test used to monitor intravenous heparin anticoagulation.

3016-3.plain_description: Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone (TSH) blood test used to evaluate thyroid gland function.

3184-9.display: Activated clotting time (ACT) of Blood by Coagulation assay
3184-9.plain_description: Point-of-care clotting time test used in the operating room during coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) to guide high-dose heparin and protamine reversal.
3184-9.reference_range: Baseline: 70–120 seconds; cardiopulmonary bypass target: > 400–480 seconds

85354-9.display: Blood pressure panel with all children optional
85354-9.plain_description: Systolic and diastolic arterial blood pressure measurement.
85354-9.reference_range: Normal: < 120/80 mmHg; Elevated: 120–129/< 80 mmHg; Hypertension: >= 130/80 or >= 140/90 mmHg

8302-2.plain_description: Standing body height measurement in centimeters.

29463-7.plain_description: Body weight measurement in kilograms, used to track nutritional status, BMI, and fluid balance.

39156-5.plain_description: Body Mass Index (BMI) ratio calculated from weight and height.

59576-9.display: Body mass index (BMI) [Percentile] Per age and sex
59576-9.plain_description: Pediatric/adolescent BMI percentile compared against CDC age- and sex-specific growth charts.

8867-4.plain_description: Resting pulse / heart rate in beats per minute.

9279-1.plain_description: Breathing rate in breaths per minute.

72514-3.display: Pain severity - 0-10 verbal numeric rating [Score] - Reported
72514-3.plain_description: Patient-reported pain intensity score on a 0 (no pain) to 10 (worst possible pain) scale.

2823-3.plain_description: Serum potassium electrolyte level critical for normal heart rhythm and muscle function.

6301-6.display: INR in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay
6301-6.plain_description: International Normalized Ratio (INR) measuring blood clotting speed on warfarin therapy.

33762-6.display: Natriuretic peptide.B prohormone N-Terminal [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma
33762-6.plain_description: NT-proBNP cardiac biomarker released when the heart wall is stretched by fluid overload or heart failure.

718-7.plain_description: Oxygen-carrying hemoglobin protein in red blood cells, monitored for anemia and blood loss.

8480-6.plain_description: Systolic arterial blood pressure (top number) measuring pressure in the arteries when the heart contracts.
8480-6.reference_range: Normal: < 120 mm[Hg]; Hypotension: < 90–100 mm[Hg]; Hypertension: >= 130–140 mm[Hg]

8462-4.plain_description: Diastolic arterial blood pressure (bottom number) measuring pressure in the arteries when the heart rests between beats.
